# Rust Gotchas

> Known Rust patterns that cause blocking, panics, or silent performance degradation. Load all HIGH entries before writing async Rust code.

## Entries

- [Blocking std::fs calls on Tokio runtime starve the executor](blocking-io-on-tokio.md): Path::exists(), metadata(), and read_dir() from std::fs block the async executor thread. Use tokio::fs or spawn_blocking instead. HIGH.
- [GUI-subsystem parent spawns visible console windows for every console child](gui-subsystem-console-child-window.md): A windows_subsystem="windows" binary has no console, so every console child (git, where, taskkill) pops a new console window; on a poll loop it flashes and steals keyboard focus. Set CREATE_NO_WINDOW (0x0800_0000). HIGH.
- [reqwest multipart streams the body and masks connect/timeout errors as body errors](reqwest-multipart-masks-transport-errors.md): With the multipart feature, connect/timeout failures surface as opaque body errors with is_connect()/is_timeout() both false, breaking retry taxonomies; hand-assemble a buffered multipart body instead. HIGH.
- [reqwest 0.13 renamed the 0.12 TLS umbrella features](reqwest-013-tls-feature-rename.md): rustls-tls-webpki-roots no longer exists; use "rustls" + "webpki-roots" (or "rustls-native-certs"). Cargo resolution fails with a missing-feature error. MEDIUM.
- [rubato 4.0 removed the FftFixed/SincFixed types; whole-clip resampling must use process_all](rubato-4-whole-clip-process-all.md): The FftFixedIn/SincFixedIn family is gone (use Fft + FixedSync + audioadapter buffers), and resampling a whole clip with one oversized process() call silently leaves the FFT startup delay in: leading silence, truncated tail. process_all trims it and returns exactly ceil(len * ratio) frames. HIGH.
- [Phonetic code equality alone must never trigger a text replacement](phonetic-code-equality-needs-confirm-guard.md): Double Metaphone collides common words with proper nouns ("matter" and "modero" both encode to MTR in rphonetic 3.0.6), so replacement needs a string-similarity confirm guard (e.g. strsim jaro_winkler >= 0.85) plus exact-only gating for words of <= 3 chars or containing digits. HIGH.
